listbox.$description: Tokens of the lists of options that `ListboxController` renders: those of `select`, `autocomplete` and `combobox`.

shadow.$description: Shadow of the list, above the page.

padding.$description: Padding of the list, around its options.

max-block-size.$description: Largest height of the list: its options scroll past it.

option-background-color-active.$description: Background color of the active option: the one the arrow keys or the pointer are on.

option-text-color-active.$description: Text color of the active option.

option-check-size.$description: Width and height of the box before an option, in a list of several choices.

option-check-gap.$description: Space between the box and the option's text.

option-check-border-width.$description: Border width of the box. Filled when the option is chosen.

status-font-size.$description: Font size of the status line, at the end of the list: “Loading…”, or the number of options it doesn't show.
